query_text: my service canada account log in

messages.content: my service canada account log in

message.content:
To **log in to My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**, go to the MSCA sign-in page and use the **same sign-in option you originally registered with**—**GCKey**, **Interac® Sign-In Partner**, or a **provincial sign-in**.[2][5]

If you’re unsure which option to use, Service Canada says your sign-in method is tied to your account, and you must use that same option every time unless you register for a different one.[2]

- **GCKey**: use your GCKey username and password.[2]
- **Interac® Sign-In Partner**: use your online banking sign-in information.[2]
- **Provincial sign-in**: available only if you registered that way, and only for certain provinces.[4]

If you have not registered yet, MSCA registration may require an **Access Code** for some services, such as Employment Insurance.[1][3]

If you want, I can also walk you through **how to recover your account** or **which login option you should use**.
